abilities.description: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.

abilities.description: Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.

abilities.description: Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.
abilities.name: Airburst

abilities.description: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.

abilities.description: Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.

abilities.description: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.

abilities.description: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
abilities.name: Artemis Bow

abilities.description:
Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.
abilities.name: Astral Shell

abilities.description: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
abilities.name: Avalanche

abilities.description: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.

Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

abilities.description: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.
abilities.name: Blade Storm

abilities.description: Restore the health and shields of allies within Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.

Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.

abilities.name: Breach Surge

Wield your foe's fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei's dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

abilities.name: Cataclysm

Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with Heat.

Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral Heat or Slash damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.
abilities.name: Celestial Clash

Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.
abilities.name: Celestial Twin

abilities.description: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
abilities.name: Chaos

abilities.name: Cloud Walker

abilities.description: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.

Hurl Sirius' Jade Light infused scythe, dealing Heat Damage while collecting any pickups in its path.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Gravitic Slash.

abilities.description: Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting Slash Damage upon them.

abilities.name: Decoy

Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.

tags.when: during the 2 s stance
on cast, 2 s
when the 2 s of invulnerability end

abilities.description: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.
abilities.name: Desiccation

(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.

Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.

Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash or Coronal Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Light's Sanctuary.

abilities.description: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.

Backbeat Timing: No Energy consumed.

(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.

Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse.

TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse.

TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse.

continuously while standing on the flames

Throw out grenades in an arc.

(TAP) SHRAPNEL VORTEX
Creates a slashing, staggering swirl of shrapnel.

(HOLD) SHIELD SATELLITES

on cast, not what lands during the cast animation

tags.when: while active with the Talons out; switching weapons ends it

abilities.name: Invisibility

Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing Heat Damage and Status Effect.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Astral Shell.

Weave the threads of destiny. Enemies who touch the threads suffer a random Elemental Status Effect.

abilities.name: Light's Judgment

Sirius creates a well of light that heals and revives allies, while reducing incoming damage. The well slowly grows in size and power.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Event Horizon.
abilities.name: Light's Sanctuary

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.

tags.when: on a triple-six roll of Five Fates, until that cast's charms are spent

Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.
abilities.name: Omikuji

abilities.description: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.

abilities.description:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with Toxin.
abilities.name: Ophidian Bite

Drive loudspeakers into epic distortion to create a damaging wave of Heat Damage while also increasing vulnerability to Critical Chance. 

Backbeat Timing: Doubles Critical Chance. Increases the Duration and Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.
abilities.name: Overdrive

abilities.description: In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.

abilities.description: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.

abilities.description: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.

abilities.description: Plunder Armor from nearby enemies and increase Corrosive Damage on your Abilities and weapons. Enemies affected by Corrosive Status offer a greater increase.
abilities.name: Plunder

abilities.description: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting Slash Status Effect.
abilities.name: Polarize

abilities.description: Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.
abilities.name: Preserving Shell

abilities.description: Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.
abilities.name: Primal Fury

abilities.description: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
abilities.name: Prism

abilities.description: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.
abilities.name: Prismatic Gem

abilities.description: Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.
abilities.name: Prowl

abilities.description: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
abilities.name: Psychic Bolts

abilities.description: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
abilities.name: Pull

abilities.description: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.
abilities.name: Pulverize

abilities.description:
Blast targeted enemies with pillars of Heat Damage. 

Backbeat Timing: Ignite even more pillars. Increases the Duration and Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.
abilities.name: Pyrotechnics

abilities.description: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
abilities.name: Quiver

abilities.description: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
abilities.name: Radial Blind

abilities.description: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
abilities.name: Radial Disarm

abilities.description: Let out ferocious howl that stuns nearby enemies and causes Sentients to shed any built up resistances.
abilities.name: Radial Howl

abilities.description: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting Slash Status.
abilities.name: Radial Javelin

abilities.description: Phantom Kaithes charge forth, inflicting Viral Damage upon all in their path. Their attack strips the defenses of Doomed enemies.
abilities.name: Rakhali's Cavalry

abilities.description: Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.
abilities.name: Rally Point

abilities.description: Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.
abilities.name: Ravenous

abilities.description: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.
abilities.name: Razor Gyre

abilities.description: Shrink down and take flight, while razorflies attack nearby enemies and amplify the damage they take.
abilities.name: Razorwing

abilities.description: Sevagoth's Shadow flies outward ravaging enemies in his path. Survivors are damaged by Death's Harvest over time. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
abilities.name: Reap

abilities.description: Dash through enemies as a wall of sentient energy, leeching shields and health from any encountered, enhanced for thralls.
abilities.name: Reave

tags.when: during the dash
during the dash, 1 s
during the dash

abilities.description: Instantly restore your shields.
abilities.name: Rebuild Shields

abilities.description: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a Health Orb when they die.
abilities.name: Reckoning

abilities.description: Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.
abilities.name: Recompense

abilities.description: Push Gauss' battery beyond the redline, supercharging his Abilities and setting Fire Rate, Attack Speed, Reload Speed, and Casting Speed into overdrive. When past the redline, bolts of arcing electricity dance periodically from Gauss, exploding en masse when the ability is deactivated.
abilities.name: Redline

abilities.description: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.
abilities.name: Regurgitate

abilities.description: Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
abilities.name: Remedium

tags.when: during the cast, shortened by Casting Speed
on cast

abilities.description: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies' Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.
abilities.name: Renewal

abilities.description: Revert to Sprodling form, spawning orbs that heal Nokko and grant a speed boost. While in this state, Nokko is untargetable and heals gradually.
abilities.name: Reroot

abilities.description: Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.
abilities.name: Reservoirs

abilities.description: Launches a rollerball that charms foes to follow it. Combines with the Mallet to create a roving ball of sonic destruction.
abilities.name: Resonator

abilities.description: In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
abilities.name: Rest & Rage

abilities.description:
Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon's magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.
abilities.name: Resupply

abilities.description: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
abilities.name: Rhino Charge

abilities.description: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
abilities.name: Rhino Stomp

abilities.description: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
abilities.name: Rift Surge

abilities.description: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
abilities.name: Rip Line

abilities.description:
Rip on the guitar to make Temple briefly invulnerable while healing them. Ally's weapons in Affinity Range are lit-up with extra Heat Damage each time an ability is used on the Backbeat and successfully hits enemies.

Backbeat Timing: Invulnerability lasts longer.
abilities.name: Ripper's Wail

abilities.description: Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.
abilities.name: Riptide

abilities.description: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
abilities.name: Roar

abilities.description: Gyre's mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.
abilities.name: Rotorswell

abilities.description: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.
abilities.name: Rumblers

abilities.description: Become a sandstorm. Inaros devours enemies pulled into his whirlwind, healing himself.
abilities.name: Sandstorm

abilities.description: Activate to form Armor by draining Inaros' Health. Activate again to stop the formation early. The protective layer reduces incoming Damage and absorbs Status Effects.
abilities.name: Scarab Shell

abilities.description: Summon a Scarab Swarm to attack enemies with guaranteed Corrosive Status. Damage scales with Inaros' Health. Enemies killed while immersed in the swarm summon a Swarm Kavat that fights alongside Inaros and guides the scarabs to other enemies.
abilities.name: Scarab Swarm

abilities.description:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.
abilities.name: Sea Snares

abilities.description: Plant an antenna that projects a forward wave scan. Detected enemies take increased Weak Point Damage, and become visible through walls. Weapons gain Punch through.
abilities.name: Seek

abilities.description: Charge to expand the targeting area, release to send Garuda's talons careening toward each target in area. Surviving enemies are prone to Slash Status.
abilities.name: Seeking Talons

abilities.description: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
abilities.name: Self Portrait

abilities.description: Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.
abilities.name: Sentient Wrath

abilities.description: With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.
abilities.name: Serene Storm

abilities.description:
Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.
abilities.name: Shadowgraph

abilities.description: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
abilities.name: Shadows of the Dead

abilities.description: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
abilities.name: Shatter Shield

abilities.description: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.
abilities.name: Shattered Lash

abilities.description: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
abilities.name: Shock

abilities.description: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
abilities.name: Shooting Gallery

abilities.description:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.
abilities.name: Shroud of Dynar

abilities.description: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
abilities.name: Shuriken

abilities.description: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of Slash, Heat, and Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer
abilities.name: Sickening Pulse

abilities.description: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.
abilities.name: Silence

abilities.description:
Unfurl Oraxia's spider legs and go on the prowl. Oraxia is immune to Status Effects and has increased Maximum Health. Ranged Weapons are imbued with  Toxin Damage. Killing enemies causes them to burst with Toxin.

Silken Thread: Tap Dodge to leap to a targeted surface.
abilities.name: Silken Stride

abilities.description: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade's slashes inflict Slash Status.
abilities.name: Slash Dash

abilities.description: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
abilities.name: Sleight of Hand

abilities.description: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
abilities.name: Smite

abilities.description: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
abilities.name: Smoke Screen

abilities.description: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
abilities.name: Snow Globe

abilities.description: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.
abilities.name: Sol Gate

abilities.description: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak points to everyone in your squad.
abilities.name: Sonar

abilities.description: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate attackers and reduce their Armor.
abilities.name: Sonic Boom

abilities.description: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
abilities.name: Soul Punch

abilities.description: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground in a targeted area.
abilities.name: Sound Quake

abilities.description: Plant a death seed in nearby targets to drain their lifeforce. Reap what has been sown to detonate afflicted enemies, dealing a percentage of their health as radial damage. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
abilities.name: Sow

abilities.description: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.
abilities.name: Spectral Scream

abilities.description: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.
abilities.name: Spectrorage

abilities.description: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.
abilities.name: Speed

abilities.description: Enemies fumble their weapons as they are whisked into the air. Nearby allies become immune to Status Effects. Hold the ability to cast the immunity onto Titania.
abilities.name: Spellbind

tags.when: for the ability's duration, inside the cloud
on cast, inside the cloud

abilities.description: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.
abilities.name: Splinter Storm

abilities.description: Inflict a target with a pox of Corrosive spores. Spread spores to nearby enemies by destroying them or killing their host. The longer the Spore spreads, its damage will increase.
abilities.name: Spores

abilities.description: Unleash a chaotic ballistic mushroom that seeks enemies and bounces explosively off whatever it touches. Contact with any of Nokko's mushrooms invigorates them, doubling their pulse rate.
abilities.name: Sporespring

abilities.description: Freezes Rift-bound enemies. While active, enemy projectiles are arrested in mid-air, resuming its trajectory when stasis ends.
abilities.name: Stasis

abilities.description: Throw a mushroom that periodically sheds poisonous spores, inflicting  Viral Damage and Status Effect upon nearby enemies while also lulling them to sleep.
abilities.name: Stinkbrain

abilities.description: The Void answers Kullervo's invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.
abilities.name: Storm of Ukko

abilities.description: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.
abilities.name: Strangledome

abilities.description: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
abilities.name: Switch Teleport

abilities.description: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.
abilities.name: Symphony of Mercy

abilities.description: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.
abilities.name: Tail Wind

abilities.description: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.
abilities.name: Tectonics

abilities.description: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
abilities.name: Teleport

abilities.description: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
abilities.name: Tempest Barrage

abilities.description:
Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.
abilities.name: Temporal Anchor

abilities.description: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
abilities.name: Tentacle Swarm

abilities.description: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
abilities.name: Terrify

abilities.description: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing  Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
abilities.name: Tesla Nervos

abilities.description: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.
abilities.name: Tharros Strike

abilities.description: Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.
abilities.name: The Lost

abilities.description: Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.
abilities.name: The Vast Untime

abilities.description: Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting Heat Status on nearby enemies.
abilities.name: Thermal Sunder

abilities.description: Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Weak Points produce extra energy.
abilities.name: Thurible

abilities.description: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
abilities.name: Tidal Surge

abilities.description: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.
abilities.name: Tornado

abilities.description: While active, attacks deal additional Toxin Damage; this effect is doubled for Melee Strikes. Instantly burst spores when attacking afflicted enemies.
abilities.name: Toxic Lash

abilities.description:
Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with Electricity.
abilities.name: Transmutation Probe

abilities.description: Cycle through and extract one of the four Buffs when cast on an enemy. Thorns reduces incoming damage. Dust degrades enemy accuracy. Full Moon increases companion damage. Entangle slows enemies within range.
abilities.name: Tribute

abilities.description: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.
abilities.name: Turbulence

abilities.description:
(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.
abilities.name: Ulfrun's Descent

abilities.description: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.
abilities.name: Venari

abilities.description: Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.
abilities.name: Vex Armor

abilities.description:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with Cold.
abilities.name: Vial Rush

abilities.description: Rupture the ground with a damaging fungal growth that steals energy from each enemy it strikes. For every five enemies hit, the Infestation mutates, multiplying its destructive force.
abilities.name: Virulence

abilities.description: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.
abilities.name: Voracious Metastasis

abilities.description: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in Affinity Range.
abilities.name: Warcry

abilities.description: Create a protective ring of fire, that also stuns and damages enemies who get too close.
abilities.name: Warding Halo

abilities.description: Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.
abilities.name: Webbed Embrace

abilities.description: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
abilities.name: Well of Life

tags.when: inside the aura; Toxin damage still lands
on fatal damage inside the aura, 5 s, a 60 s cooldown per ally

abilities.description: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.
abilities.name: Whipclaw

abilities.description: Oraxia launches a barrage of stinging darts in front of her that applies  Toxin Status Effect. Poisoned enemies spawn Scuttlers when killed.
abilities.name: Widow's Brood

abilities.description: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.
abilities.name: Wil-O-Wisp

abilities.description: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
abilities.name: Wormhole

abilities.description:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.
abilities.name: Wrathful Advance

tags.when: during a tap cast's wind-up, not on a hold-cast teleport

abilities.description: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.
abilities.name: Wyrd Scythes

abilities.description: Wield Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.
abilities.name: Xata's Whisper
